summary.headline: Moon Separating from Mars
summary.text: Astrological mundane predictions for the Moon’s post-separation conjunction with Mars in Taurus, Gemini, and Cancer, interpreted through conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition. The forecasts cover war, sedition, weather, prices, roads, merchants, soldiers, rulers, commoners, and regional enemies.
